name: Escape - Backrooms Horror VR
summary: Escape – Backrooms Horror VR plunges you into a surreal and claustrophobic world where reality feels warped and danger lurks around every corner. You awaken in dimly lit, maze-like corridors with no memory of how you got there, and your only goal is to find a way out. Every room holds secrets, puzzles, and hidden clues, but the darkness is not empty—traps and creatures roam, ready to turn your exploration into a nightmare.
